# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> The Lytchett has been carefully crafted with the modern family in mind. A generous kitchen and dining area offer a spacious and practical space, with a separate living room providing a light and airy haven for rest and relaxation. Upstairs benefits from 4 well-proportioned bedrooms, including an en-suite to the main bedroom and a family bathroom.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Plocha: 126 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Plot 267, Yeovil
- Cena: £495,000
